variants.name: Как исходные тайлы
variants.style: VARIANT 1 — CLOSEST TO ORIGINAL: preserve the exact tiny compact chibi body proportions of the input sprites. Recognizability comes only from the three simple Kingdom Rush color/gear cues. Strong plain chunky silhouettes with coarse dark-plum outline, restrained earthy colors. Visually the most faithful continuation of the supplied screenshot. Do not add detail that the original sprites do not have.
variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Task: edit the attached isometric battlefield image for a game art-direction study. The USER CORRECTION is essential: THE CHARACTERS MUST USE EXACTLY THE SAME CRUDE, LARGE-PIXEL VISUAL LANGUAGE AS THE TILES. The entire scene must look drawn by one pixel artist at one small native resolution.
Preserve the supplied image's floating diamond board, isometric square tile grid, stream path, terrain colors and distribution, exposed block sides, plum background, camera and framing. The existing tiny figures demonstrate the CORRECT size, pixel coarseness, contour and detail budget. Replace only their designs with very simplified Kingdom Rush characters, not their low-detail pixel drawing style.
Exactly six small units in the same locations and at essentially the SAME SIZE as the input sprites: paladin Sir Gerald Lightseeker at left middle, ranger Alleria Swiftwind at upper left, mage Magnus Spellbane at lower left; helmeted green axe orc at upper right and two small green goblins at middle-right and lower-right.
Gerald recognizable by ONE chunky blue plume, simple silver helmet/armor, blue cloth, plain sword and plain shield. Alleria recognizable by ONE blonde ponytail shape, green tunic/cape, brown bow and small quiver. Magnus recognizable by ONE upright dark hair shape, purple robe, cream collar and gold staff with a SMALL flat violet orb; no wizard hat and no white beard. Orc: green head, iron helmet, brown outfit, blunt blocky axe. Goblins: tiny green heads with wide pointy ears and brown outfits. Faces are very simple pixel patches, no detailed facial illustration.
CRITICAL SCALE/STYLE: heroes about 80-100 output pixels high, goblins about 60-70, orc about 95-110 on a 1536x1024 image, similar to the ORIGINAL. Think tiny 12-16-logical-pixel-tall sprites enlarged with nearest-neighbor. Visible square pixel clusters roughly 6-8 output pixels wide, coordinated with the tile-edge steps. Compact solid connected forms; broad horizontal/vertical strokes; blocky stair-step diagonals. At most 2-3 flat shades per material, one broad highlight, one broad shadow. Dark plum/brown contour of the SAME coarse grid as the tiles. One tiny flat pixel footprint shadow, no smooth oval shadows. Weapons are short simple silhouettes and never decorative detailed objects.
Do NOT upgrade or embellish the terrain to match detailed characters: simplify the characters to match the existing terrain.
Avoid ALL smooth vector/comic contours, antialiasing, hi-res illustration pasted on pixel tiles, tiny trim, armor rivets, shield emblems, divided fingers, individual hair strands, realistic anatomy, soft 3D shading, glossy highlights, particles, magic flames, bloom, glow haze, dithering, texture noise, giant heads or enlarged units. Plain violet orb only. No HUD, labels, lettering, logo, watermark, inset, comparison sheet, extra character. One landscape 1536x1024 scene.
